scenario: [LUNI.4.5.1] position 2: an `implicit` unit formula auto-applies at a cross-dimension `where` comparison between two pattern-bound variables. `a.freq > b.period` compares a frequency (Hz) with a time (nanosecond), and the program compiles because `hz_period` applies there. NOT HERE: which operand converts and the operator flip `inverting` adds, [LUNI.4.5.2]. A `compile_ok` cannot see which operator the comparison lowered to; logical/LUNI.4.5.2_inverting_flips_the_operator and logical/LUNI.4.5.2_non_inverting_keeps_the_operator run them on both runtimes.
rules_ds:
unit dimension frequency storage float64 base Hz
unit Hz: frequency

unit formula hz_period inverting implicit:
    hz_to_period(x: Hz): nanosecond  = 1e9 / x
    period_to_hz(x: nanosecond): Hz  = 1e9 / x

schema A scope logical:
    freq: Hz key
schema B scope logical:
    period: nanosecond key

rule cmp:
    A a
    B b where a.freq > b.period
->
    log info "matched"
